To learn more, view the following link: Privacy Notice Manage Preferences Skip to main content Events Plan Your Event Attendees Exhibit Corporate Responsibility About INFORMS Annual Meeting 2026 The Leading Conference for Analytics, Operations Research, and Data Science IN-PERSON | November 1-4, 2026 | Moscone Center | San Francisco, CA, USA The INFORMS Annual Meeting 2026 is a premier international conference focused on advancing analytics, operations research, data science, and decision-making. Hosted at Moscone Center in San Francisco, this flagship event brings together researchers, practitioners, educators, and industry leaders to explore innovative methods and real-world applications across a wide range of industries. Attendees will participate in a comprehensive program of presentations, panels, tutorials, and networking opportunities designed to foster collaboration and knowledge exchange. The INFORMS Annual Meeting serves as a global forum for cutting-edge research and applied insights in optimization, machine learning, supply chain, healthcare, finance, and more. Key highlights include: Technical Sessions & Research Presentations – Discover the latest advancements in analytics, optimization, and data-driven decision-making. Tutorials & Workshops – Gain hands-on knowledge from leading experts across academia and industry. Industry & Applied Analytics Sessions – Explore real-world use cases and solutions across sectors including healthcare, transportation, finance, and technology. Networking & Community Engagement – Connect with peers, researchers, and professionals from around the world. INFORMS Annual Meeting 2026 brings the global analytics and operations research community together to advance innovation, insight, and impact. Mark your calendar and join INFORMS in San Francisco at Moscone Center. NOVEMBER 1 - NOVEMBER 4, 2026 Moscone South 443-757-3500 informs@informs.org Welcome to The Moscone Center!
